description_en: Invoke CreateInstance to create a Cloud Contact Center instance
description_zh: 调用CreateInstance创建一个云联络中心实例
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-instance --name '测试实例' --description '云联络中心的测试实例。' --domain-name ccc-test --number-list 0830011xxxx_,_0830312xxxx --admin-ram-id-list 248613806810700000_,_1059803544820000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: Instance name. The length must be between 4 and 32 characters
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 云联络中心的测试实例。
parameters.help_en: Description of the instance. The length must not exceed 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 实例的描述，长度不超过256个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Second-level domain name of the Cloud Contact Center instance, which serves as the instance ID and is globally unique. It must be 4 to 48 characters long and can only contain uppercase and lowercase English letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 云联络中心实例的二级域名，即实例ID，全局唯一。长度为4-48个字符，仅可包含大小写英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: List of phone numbers for the Cloud Contact Center instance to be created. The current account must have usage rights to these numbers, and the numbers must not be associated with any other instance
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的云联络中心实例的号码列表，要求当前账户拥有号码使用权且号码未被其他实例使用
parameters.name: number_list

parameters.help_en: List of RAM IDs to be assigned as administrators of this Cloud Contact Center instance. After successful creation, the RAM IDs in this list will be automatically imported into the newly created instance with administrator privileges
parameters.help_zh: 作为该云联络中心实例管理员的RAM ID列表，成功创建后，该列表下的RAM ID将自动以管理员的身份导入到新创建的实例中
parameters.name: admin_ram_id_list
